messages.content: 一位化學家正在進行一個實驗，使用一個2公斤的特定物質A樣本。實驗開始時，該物質的初始溫度為攝氏25度。然後，化學家將物質加熱到最終溫度攝氏75度。該實驗在1大氣壓力下進行。化學家重複進行相同物質的實驗，但這次的初始溫度為攝氏10度，最終溫度為攝氏50度。你能計算出在這兩個實驗的設定初始和最終條件下，物質的熵變化嗎？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.content:
**Entropy change (ΔS)**  
For a reversible heating process at constant pressure the change in entropy of a sample of mass \(m\) with a (approximately) constant molar or specific heat capacity \(c_{p}\) is  

\[
\Delta S \;=\; m\,c_{p}\,\ln\!\left(\frac{T_{\text{final}}}{T_{\text{initial}}}\right)
\]

where temperatures are expressed in kelvin.

---

### 1. Experiment 1  
- Mass \(m = 2\;\text{kg}\)  
- Initial temperature \(T_i = 25^{\circ}\text{C} = 298\;\text{K}\)  
- Final temperature \(T_f = 75^{\circ}\text{C} = 348\;\text{K}\)

\[
\boxed{\displaystyle 
\Delta S_1 \;=\; 2\,c_{p}\,\ln\!\left(\frac{348}{298}\right)}
\]

If we take a typical specific‑heat value for many liquids or solids, e.g. \(c_{p}=1\;\text{kJ}\,(\text{kg}\cdot\text{K})^{-1}\),

\[
\Delta S_1 \approx 2\times 1 \times \ln(1.168)\;\text{kJ/K}
          \approx 0.31\;\text{kJ/K}.
\]

---

### 2. Experiment 2  
- Mass \(m = 2\;\text{kg}\)  
- Initial temperature \(T_i = 10^{\circ}\text{C} = 283\;\text{K}\)  
- Final temperature \(T_f = 50^{\circ}\text{C} = 323\;\text{K}\)

\[
\boxed{\displaystyle 
\Delta S_2 \;=\; 2\,c_{p}\,\ln\!\left(\frac{323}{283}\right)}
\]

With the same assumed \(c_{p}=1\;\text{kJ}\,(\text{kg}\cdot\text{K})^{-1}\),

\[
\Delta S_2 \approx 2\times 1 \times \ln(1.141)\;\text{kJ/K}
          \approx 0.26\;\text{kJ/K}.
\]

---

#### Summary (in terms of \(c_{p}\))

| Experiment | ΔS (kJ/K) |
|------------|-----------|
| 1 (25 °C → 75 °C) | \(2\,c_{p}\,\ln(348/298)\) |
| 2 (10 °C → 50 °C) | \(2\,c_{p}\,\ln(323/283)\) |

If you have the exact specific heat capacity of substance **A**, simply substitute it into the formulas above to obtain the precise numerical values.
